text_block_list.text:
Undeterred by an exceptionally heavy 
track, Mr. C.B. conquered the Satsuki Sho. 
The crowd showered her performance with 
praise.

Though it was a race that left her covered 
head-to-toe in mud, Mr. C.B. ran through 
it thoroughly enjoying herself.

The next goal is the Japanese Derby. Mr. 
C.B. eagerly anticipated a fierce battle 
on the grand stage where the top prospects 
of their generation would gather.
